verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists a Zapier integration, which covers the 'thousands of apps' part of the story. Otter also documents sending notes and action items to Airtable, ClickUp, Jira, Asana and Google Drive. The evidence never mentions native Slack or Notion delivery, two of the three named destinations, and the Zapier support is a single pricing-line mention with no workflow detail. missing for 10: native Slack channel posting, Notion page sync, documented depth of Zapier triggers/actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
